title: Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) Government Share and the Fiscal-Year Benefit Cap
content:
## Rule

The government share for Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) benefits other than ECHO Home Health Care is limited to the fiscal-year benefit cap per beneficiary per federal fiscal year of the service date (the fiscal-year benefit used); a line that crosses the cap is paid only up to the amount remaining and the rest is the family's to pay. The monthly cost share is taken from the government share of the first claim of the month. ECHO Home Health Care is limited separately under the ECHO Home Health Care cap rule. Services the basic TRICARE program covers are paid by the basic program, never by ECHO, and other health insurance pays first.

The fiscal-year benefit cap, the separate ECHO Home Health Care limit and the rounding of the government share are the terms of the product's benefit limits schedule.

## Definitions

**Fiscal-year benefit used.** For one beneficiary and one federal fiscal year (October 1 through September 30) containing the service date: the total of the government share paid on that beneficiary's ECHO claim lines for services other than ECHO Home Health Care, less the government share withdrawn by reversals of those lines.

**Amount remaining.** The fiscal-year benefit cap less the fiscal-year benefit used, or zero if that difference would be below zero.

**Government share paid on a line.** The lower of the line's allowed amount and the amount remaining.

Each paid line adds its government share to the fiscal-year benefit used for its beneficiary and fiscal year; each reversal withdraws the government share of the line it reverses. Any part of a line's allowed amount above the government share paid is the family's to pay.

## Worked examples on hypothetical figures

*The used amounts and allowed amounts below are hypothetical inputs. The cap figure is the product's fiscal-year benefit cap of 36000.00.*

| Example | Fiscal-year benefit used before the line | Amount remaining | Allowed amount of the line | Government share paid | Family's to pay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 30000.00 | 6000.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 0.00 |
| 2 | 35200.00 | 800.00 | 1500.00 | 800.00 | 700.00 |
| 3 | 36000.00 | 0.00 | 1500.00 | 0.00 | 1500.00 |

*Example 4 (reversal).* A beneficiary's paid lines in the fiscal year total 36000.00 and one of them, of 400.00, has been reversed. The fiscal-year benefit used is 36000.00 less 400.00, that is 35600.00, so the amount remaining is 400.00; a new line with an allowed amount of 1000.00 is paid 400.00.

*Example 5 (ECHO Home Health Care).* ECHO Home Health Care lines add nothing to the fiscal-year benefit used, whatever their amount; a beneficiary whose only paid lines in the year are ECHO Home Health Care lines has the whole cap remaining for other ECHO benefits.

## Points of judgement

- **Which year.** The fiscal year is the one containing the service date. A service on September 30 counts in the fiscal year ending that day; a service on October 1 counts in the fiscal year beginning that day.
- **Whose cap.** The cap is the beneficiary's own; the lines of a sibling are never counted in it.
- **Basic program and other insurance.** A service the basic TRICARE program covers is paid by the basic program and never by ECHO, and other health insurance pays before ECHO.
